archive_max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth when scanning nested archives.

archive_max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of an individual file inside an archive to scan.

archive_max_files.description: Maximum number of files to scan inside a single archive.

bytecode_enabled.description: Enable the ClamAV bytecode interpreter for modern signatures.

bytecode_timeout.description: Seconds before a bytecode instruction times out (to prevent hangs).

daemon_user.description: System user account under which the daemon runs for security isolation.

database_dir.description: Directory containing ClamAV signature databases (main.cvd, daily.cvd, bytecode.cvd).

debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debugging output. Set to false for production.

exclude_paths.description: List of paths (glob or regex patterns) to skip during scanning.

extra_signatures.description: Optional additional signature files (e.g., .cvd or .ndb paths).

heuristic_precedence.description: Prefer heuristic detection over exact matches (useful for unknown threats).

idle_timeout.description: Seconds before a client connection is closed due to inactivity.

include_paths.description: List of paths to scan exclusively (if IncludePath support is enabled).

log_file_path.description: Log file path for clamd operations.

log_file_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size (in MB) before rotation.

log_rotate.description: Enable log rotation when log file size exceeds MaxSize.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections (e.g., mail workers).

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size of a single file to scan. Larger files are skipped.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to scan in one directory tree.

max_recursion.description: Maximum recursion depth when scanning nested directories.

max_scan_size_mb.description: Maximum total size (in MB) of data scanned in one operation (e.g., full message).

on_access_enabled.description: Enable real-time on-access scanning (clamonacc functionality). Introduced in ClamAV 0.102.0.

pid_file_path.description: Absolute path where the daemon writes its process ID.

pua_categories.description: List of PUA categories to scan for. Options: All, Archive, Compression, Email, Exploit, Lang, Packed, PDF, Shellcode.

pua_enabled.description: Enable detection of Potentially Unwanted Applications (PUA).

scan_archive.description: Scan inside archive formats (ZIP, RAR, etc.).

scan_html.description: Scan HTML content for malicious scripts.

scan_ole2.description: Scan OLE2 containers (e.g., Microsoft Office documents).

socket_group.description: Group ownership of the socket file (e.g., 'clamav' or 'postfix').

socket_mode.description: File permissions for the socket (octal string like '660').

socket_path.description: Unix domain socket path for local client communication.

stream_max_length_mb.description: Maximum total size (in MB) of data streamed to clamd.

stream_max_port.description: Maximum TCP port number for network stream scanning.

stream_min_port.description: Minimum TCP port number for network stream scanning (if enabled).

update_log_path.description: Log file path for signature updates (used by freshclam).
